module.purpose: Defines the lifecycle state model, timing constants, permissions, protocol capabilities, and state-specific data for one collaborative room WebSocket session.
module.summary: This module provides the type-safe data model for a server-side collaborative room connection. It models sessions as a discriminated union covering initial connection, deferred removal, and active synchronization, while sharing identity, socket, metadata, permissions, protocol compatibility, and object-store access across states. Connected sessions additionally track schema information, migration requirements, interaction timestamps, debouncing, and queued outbound data.
module.businessContext: Supports real-time collaborative rooms by representing each connected client and its synchronization lifecycle. Incorrect state or permission modeling can break reconnection handling, authorization, cleanup, or document synchronization.
classes: RoomSessionBase (~L72-99): Shared identity, socket, metadata, permissions, and protocol capabilities
